user.title: Select controller
user.description: Pick the controller. Every reachable Bluetooth device is listed, because a controller does not always advertise what it is — likely matches are marked.

pin.title: Enter PIN
pin.description: Enter the PIN printed in the manual of {name}.

data_description.zone: Which ventilation zone this entry controls. Zone 0 is the first zone.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter PIN
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected the stored PIN. Enter it again.

manual.title: Enter address
manual.description: Enter the controller's Bluetooth address, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller. Make sure it is in range of an adapter or Bluetooth proxy.
error.invalid_address: That is not a valid Bluetooth address.

abort.no_devices_found: No Bluetooth device is reachable. Check that an adapter or Bluetooth proxy is in range of the controller.

data_description.keep_connected: Faster commands, but the inVENTer app cannot connect while Home Assistant holds the link.
